gloss: to carry out; to haul out; to remove

definitions.gloss: to carry out; to haul out
definitions.explanation: To carry something from inside a place to outside it. The 〜{出|だ}す half supplies the outward direction, so the focus is on getting the object out rather than on where it ends up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}す。
⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please carry the desk out into the hallway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧がかり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Several of them together carried the collapsed person out of the building.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}す. The starting point takes ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ or ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, the destination ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}す: to move furniture out
- ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}す: to haul out of the warehouse
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運|はこ}び{出|だ}す: to carry out the injured

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運|はこ}び{込|こ}む→運び込む：30545_hakobikomu⟧: to carry in — the opposite direction
- ⟦{持|も}ち{出|だ}す→持ち出す：06160_mochidasu⟧: to take out — often means removing without permission, or bringing up a topic
